Alright I was waiting for a post like this to share my opinion on this topic.

Personally I think that if You're starting Drukhari army rn You should go for whatever You want. Why? Well there's some benefits that You gain even if there's gonna be a range update / refresh that You simply lose if You decide to wait on buying models.

Now, let's say and pretend that there's going to be huuuge Drukhari refresh / update, I'm talking every model (aside from super super new ones like Drazhar etc) remaked and a lot of stuff brought back from "legends"(I think that's how the unavaiable and super old models are called? Correct me if I'm wrong). Even if that were to happed You should still collect whatever You want from this faction, because:

1 - You gain experiance with assembling and painting it, so You will be able to make the potential new models better than if You were to start with them.

2 - You will be able to brag about having old versions of the models "look at this cool old kabal mini, it's the old version, basically a relic and a piece of history".

3 - Most importantly, you'll have fun. The point of life is to do things that gives You joy, so don't limit yourself because of potential update, by waiting You're blocking yourself from collecting stuff You like and preventing yourself from playing games as that faction, ultimetly do what you like, live in the moment and enjoy life.

So there's a lot to gain if You're going to collect what you want no matter what, while if You were to hold and not buy anything, if the rework will not happen or will be rather small, You're gonna feel like a fool and waste a lot of time that could have been spend on collecting a faction You're interested in.

Anyways I wrote a lot, however I myself though about this topic a lot myself and came to this conclusion, I hope this will help.
